title: Citation
description: A traceable reference to an external source backing a fact, mapping, or claim made by a canonical object. Every governance statement must be able to point to at least one of these.

id.description: Identifier for this citation, unique within the owning object's citations array.

source_type.description: The category of source this citation points to.

title.description: Title of the cited work (e.g. article headline, judgment name, standard title).

publisher.description: The organisation or body responsible for the source (e.g. 'Reuters', 'European Commission', 'NIST').

url.description: Direct link to the source, when one exists online.

publication_date.description: Date the source was originally published or issued, if known.

accessed_date.description: Date the source was retrieved/verified by the contributor. Required so stale or link-rotted citations can be identified.

locator.description: A precise pointer within the source (e.g. 'Article 6(2)', 'p. 12', 'para 45') that anchors the specific claim being cited.

excerpt.description: A direct, short quotation from the source supporting the claim it is attached to.
